# Whisper Model Notice

The model `onnx-community/whisper-base` is downloaded from Hugging Face (`https://huggingface.co/onnx-community/whisper-base`) at runtime upon user request and is not bundled with this extension.

It is an ONNX conversion of `openai/whisper-base`, originally released by OpenAI and licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
